What's Changed

## New Features

- Save Caddy-affecting changes as pending configuration and apply them together when ready.
- Show pending configuration changes in a compact dialog with affected web hosts and global settings.

## Optimizations

- Keep MCP token changes active immediately because they do not require a Caddy reload.

## Bug Fixes

- Show the pending-change indicator only when a Caddy configuration update is actually required.
- Refresh the pending status after combined settings and authentication changes.
